description: Chibi child air-queen sorceress, tall jeweled gold crown with blue gems, dark wavy hair, stern narrowed eyes, white fur-trimmed cloak with gold swirl embroidery and blue diamond gems, standing on grassy hill, one hand raised summoning a swirling white wind orb with feathers, swirling breeze trails and floating feathers around her, distant misty mountains, bright blue sky with clouds, flat cel-shaded cartoon style, bold black outlines, vibrant saturated colors, soft even lighting, front-facing symmetrical pose.
